messages:
harper_fin: noticed an unauthorized manual credit on client Zephyr's invoice INV-2028-0891. invoice total = $27,360 but our usage reconciliation is $29,760. there's a -$2,400 'manual_credit' line with no memo.
dan_sales: did Zephyr request any credits through their account manager?
harper_fin: checked CRM notes, nothing recorded. partner portal shows no discount memos.
leo_ops: pulling bill generator logs now.
billing-bot: auto-match: INV-2028-0891 -> commit C-ZEP-2028Q1. detected MANUAL_CREDIT amount=-2400 flagged for review.
leo_ops: billgen snippet:
```
2028-03-22T14:02:07Z BILLGEN INFO invoice=INV-2028-0891 commit=C-ZEP-2028Q1 base=29760 adjustments_applied=[{"code":"MANUAL_CREDIT","amount":-2400}] total=27360
```

harper_fin: that log suggests a manual credit was applied in BillGen, but there's no author recorded.
dan_sales: i pinged Zephyr AM. they deny requesting credit and say accounting hasn't received any credit memo.
leo_ops: possible causes: 1) billing UI submitted a credit and the audit trail didn't persist, 2) an operator ran a one-off adjuster script, 3) an automation misinterpreted a partner flag. i'll grep the ops audit logs.
billing-bot: ops-audit: no interactive adjustments recorded for INV-2028-0891. last operator action for account Zephyr was config change on 2028-02-28 by leo_ops.
harper_fin: finance has put INV-2028-0891 on hold. do not collect. we need an authorization note before we release.
leo_ops: found a cron job run at 2028-03-20 that applied bulk credits for a remediation batch BG-9648. looks like Zephyr matched the remediation filter erroneously (their account_id matched a substring in the remediation rule). opening BG-9649 to fix filter logic.
dan_sales: if Zephyr was remediated in error we should reverse the credit and reissue invoice. warn customer in advance.
ceo_revenue: hold payment until resolved. if error is ours, issue corrected invoice and offer an apology. authorizing finance to issue up to $500 goodwill credit if customer pushes back.
harper_fin: plan: 1) engineering to fix filter logic (BG-9649). 2) regenerate INV-2028-0891 after fix. 3) if payment already posted, create receivable adjustment and coordinate refund or invoice correction. finance created memo FIN-5912.
leo_ops: hotfix PR created to tighten remediation match to full account_id. CI pending. will push once green. estimate regen ETA 2028-03-24T06:00:00Z.
billing-bot: regen-queue: invoices tagged BG-9649 queued for regen post-fix.
dan_sales: i've informed Zephyr: "we found an unexpected credit on your statement; we're investigating and will follow up within 48h. no action required on your side."
harper_fin: thanks. finance will not release the hold until we confirm the credit was intentional. please post CI/deploy logs here.
leo_ops: CI passed, deploying now. logs:
```
2028-03-23T09:12:45Z DEPLOY INFO billgen fix BG-9649 applied
2028-03-23T09:13:02Z DEPLOY INFO remediation-filter: match-mode=strict
```

billing-bot: regen started for BG-9649 tagged invoices. progress: 1/1 queued. ETA 2028-03-24T06:00:00Z.
harper_fin: once regen completes we'll reconcile and either lift hold or proceed with corrected invoice. keeping this thread open for any related invoices that show MANUAL_CREDIT without audit author.
dan_sales: Zephyr replied: "Thanks for the heads up. Please let us know the corrected invoice once ready." :thumbsup:
